risk_note: RV2 (orders/**). Claim submission POST / GET /v1/orders/claims (BR-ATTR-17 / BR-ATTR-19): checks in order inside a per-user advisory lock (daily claim count from PG; failure count and day ban in Redis, fail-closed 50001; a retry with the same key and body counts once), share orders removed before matching, PDD dash-insensitive; claim_items written and the claim set through transitionClaim(); POST runs in the idempotency transactional mode so the claim rows and the stored response commit together; replay before the min-version gate (BR-ID-01). Lands back to back with B1-10c (orchestrator ruling D10-72 A), which computes the evidence in the same transaction so POST only returns auto_matched / manual_review.
